# Arch Electric

> Licensed electrical contractor serving Santa Cruz, Monterey, San Benito, and Santa Clara counties. 20+ years experience. A+ is my only standard.

## About

Arch Electric is a full-service electrical company based in Prunedale, California, owned and operated by Levi Mentz. With over 20 years of experience, Arch Electric serves residential and commercial customers across 4 counties on California's Central Coast. California Electrical Contractor License #945992.

## Services

- Electrical Panel Upgrades (100A to 200A+)
- EV Charger Installation (Tesla, ChargePoint, all brands)
- Solar & Battery Systems (Tesla Powerwall, Enphase)
- Whole-Home Generators (Generac, Kohler)
- Complete Home Rewires
- Knob & Tube Wiring Replacement
- New Construction Wiring
- Landscape & Outdoor Lighting
- Ceiling Fan Installation
- Outlet & Switch Upgrades
- Dedicated Circuits (hot tub, workshop, kitchen)
- Electrical Safety Inspections
- Commercial Electrical Services
- Emergency Electrical Repair

## Service Area

Santa Cruz County, Monterey County, San Benito County, Santa Clara County — including Santa Cruz, Monterey, Salinas, Watsonville, Capitola, Aptos, Scotts Valley, Soquel, Hollister, Prunedale, Pacific Grove, Seaside, Marina, and surrounding communities.
